files.content:
# Pixel Snakes & Ladders

A small, offline, single-player Snakes and Ladders game built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## Play

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. Select **Roll** (or focus it and press Enter or Space) to roll a six-sided die and move your token. Ladders climb upward, snakes slide downward, and reaching square 30 wins.

## Board

- Ladders: 3 → 11, 8 → 17, 20 → 29
- Snakes: 14 → 6, 24 → 16, 28 → 19

The app makes no network requests and has no external dependencies.
